title: Time-Resolved Serial Femtosecond Crystallography at the European X-ray Free Electron Laser
protocol: Use 50 μL of glycerol stock of PYP expressing, recombinant E. coli to inoculate 100 mL of ampicillin containing LB media in a 250ml flask.
Grow the culture overnight at 37°C.
Prepare four 2 L flasks with 1 L ampicillin containing LB media and inoculate each with ~20 mL from the 100 mL overnight culture.
Let the cultures grow at 37°C until OD600 reaches 0.6-0.8.
Induce cultures with IPTG (1 mmol/L final concentration) and shake at 16°C for 20 – 24 hrs.
Harvest cells by centrifugation.
Re-suspend cells (20 g) in lysis buffer (50 mL; 20 mM HEPES, 200 mM NaCl, 5 mM Imidazole, pH 7.4).
Add lysozyme and protease inhibitor to the re-suspended cells.
Sonicate the cell suspension five times for one minute each.
Clarify the cell debris by centrifugation at 4°C.
Pour supernatant into a beaker and slowly add activated pCA anhydride with stirring.
Stir the beaker overnight at 4°C.
Prepare a DCC solution by dissolving 6.25 gm of DCC in 2.5 ml DMF.
Dissolve 0.328 gm of p-coumaric acid in 7 ml DMF.
Add 1 ml of DCC solution into the p-coumaric solution and stir on ice overnight in a closed container.
Centrifuge the protein-pCA mixture to remove excess pCA.
Load the supernatant on the column containing 40 mL of pre-charged and pre-calibrated Ni²⁺ resin.
Rinse the column with Lysis buffer after loading the protein.
Wash the column with wash buffer (20 mmol/L HEPES, 200 mmol/L NaCl, 10 mmol/L Imidazole, pH 7.4).
Elute the column with elution buffer (same as wash buffer but with 200 mmol/L imidazole) and collect the elute in a fresh breaker.
Dialyze the elute overnight in dialysis buffer (20 mmol/L HEPES, 200 mmol/L NaCl, pH 7.4).
Concentrate the elute to around 10 mL.
Check the protein concentration at 446nm (OD₄₄₆/45000 x 14700 x dilution factor).
Add 20 μL enterokinase and rock the mixture for 3 days at room temperature to cleave the His tag.
Centrifuge the mixture after completion of the enterokinase reaction to remove potential precipitate.
Re-load the protein onto the Nickel column and elute with lysis buffer, collecting the yellowish flow-through.
Wash the un-cleaved PYP from the column using elution buffer.
Freeze the washed PYP for later cleavage.
Concentrate the HIS tag free PYP to 10 ml.
Purify the PYP by Anion Exchange Chromatography using a FPLC system.
Elute the PYP with a NaCl gradient (25 mmol/L Tris pH 8 without NaCl to 1 mol/L NaCl).
Collect all tubes with a yellow solution.
Measure absorption spectra for each tube.
Pool tubes where the ratio of absorption at 446nm to that at 280nm is at least 2.
Dialyze combined protein in storage buffer (pH 6.0, 50mmol/L sodium citrate).
Concentrate protein to 30-50mg/ml.
Aliquot concentrated protein into 400uL portions.
Sterile filter aliquoted protein using spin filters.
Freeze filtered protein at -80°C.
Ship frozen protein tubes to the European XFEL for onsite crystallization in a dry nitrogen shipper.
Concentrate protein to 100mg/ml and combine several tubes to a final volume of 2-3 ml.
Under vigorous stirring, add 4mol/L Sodium Malonate, pH 7 (around 14 mL) to the protein to achieve a final concentration of 3.3 mol/L.
Stir suspension in a closed vial for around 8 hours and let it rest for 24 hours at room temperature.
Centrifuge slurry in 15 mL conical tubes.
Exchange clear solution below floating microcrystals with 7 mL of 2.8 mol/L Sodium Malonate, pH 7.
Check crystal concentration and size homogeneity using a Neubauer cell-counting chamber under a microscope (400x).
Filter crystal slurry twice through a 10um steel filter.
Load the protein slurry into a 2 mL reservoir.
Prepare the reservoir so that no air is between the Teflon plunger and the water line.
Press on the water line with a 10 mL syringe filled with water to press out the protein solution until it leaks out of the protein line.
Mount the reservoir on top of the beamline vacuum chamber.
Connect the reservoir's water line to an HPLC.
Connect the reservoir's protein line to the injector nozzle capillary.
Inject the microcrystalline slurry into the vacuum using a Gas Dynamic Virtual Nozzle (GDVN) mounted on a nozzle rod reaching from ambient pressure into the vacuum chamber.
Provide synthetic mineral oil through a T-junction outside the nozzle rod to support injection and improve jetting behavior.
Set flow rates at least 35 μL/min for a 75 μm inner diameter nozzle capillary.
Set up upstream interaction for injection experiment by installing catcher and shroud in sample chamber.
Establish accelerator bunch pattern according to sample jetting behavior.
Verify X-ray focus at the sample position using optical imaging of Ce:YAG mounted on nozzle rod.
Align SASE1 beamline offset mirrors to previously recorded SPB/SFX instrument settings.
Verify the beam position against aperture set by entrance slits to micron-scale KB mirror system, adjust with translation and pitch of second (downstream) offset mirror.
Verify beam position at entrance to interaction region to ensure focus at sample.
Establish water jet and establish jet---X-ray overlap in the side-view interaction microscope.
Verify jet---pump-laser overlap by reference to jet---X-ray overlap in the side-view interaction microscope.
Mount a 100 mm thick SrTiO3 substrate onto nozzle rod for pre-experiment preparation.
Establish spatial and temporal overlap of X-ray beam and pump laser at sample position.
Establish relative ‘time zero’ reading at the ‘Pulse Arrival Time Monitor (PAM)’.
Adjust laser phase-shifter timing to previously established SPB/SFX settings.
Verify laser timing with PAM reading.
Verify required laser pulse pattern relative to X-ray pulse pattern.
Verify delay of laser pulse relative to X-ray pulse.
Run “preprocess-dk hg-run mg-run lg-run” in a Linux terminal where hg-run, mg-run and lg-run are run numbers for high gain, medium gain and low gain.
Execute quick_calib.pro using IDL and select the “dark_joined_constants_xfel.h5” file (generated previously).
Use Cheetah for hit-finding with peak finding algorithm number 8 with parameters minSNR=8, minADC=200, minPixel = 1 and minPeaks=25.
Choose XGANDALF from CrystFEL suite for indexing.
Scale Fo_ref using proper scaling software provided by the ccp4 suite of programs.
Scale time-resolved TR-SFX amplitudes (Fo_t) to reference amplitudes accurately.
Calculate difference amplitudes, deltaF_obs = Fo_t - Fo_ref.
Calculate a weighted difference map (deltaRho_obs) using phases from the reference model.
